artifact: Issue #9 M4-1 canonical mutation result contract

canonical_mutation_envelope.status: operation-level processing status; not the effect state
canonical_mutation_envelope.result: bounded operation result classification; not a claim of external effect
canonical_mutation_envelope.errors: machine-readable errors, distinct from semantic choices and effect state
canonical_mutation_envelope.semantic_choices: explicit choices required from an external semantic decision maker
canonical_mutation_envelope.mutation_effect: one enum value from the platform-neutral effect state set
canonical_mutation_envelope.effect_evidence: bounded authoritative readback/evidence references; no credentials or platform payload required

NO_EFFECT.meaning: no requested mutation took effect; includes bounded successful no-op where no new effect was requested

APPLIED_VERIFIED.meaning: the requested authoritative mutation was applied and verified

REPLAYED_VERIFIED.meaning: an exact prior authoritative effect was replayed from committed identity and verified/reused

BLOCKED.meaning: required mechanical or governance prerequisite prevented an attempt

CONFLICT.meaning: the requested intent or precondition conflicts with an existing identity/state; no new requested effect is confirmed

NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE.meaning: an external semantic decision is required before a bounded mutation can be selected

OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.meaning: an external attempt may have happened but authoritative effect cannot yet be determined

FAILED_NO_EFFECT.meaning: failure is proven before or during the attempt with no requested authoritative effect

rules: CONFLICT -> no new requested effect confirmed

error_choice_separation.NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE: choice required; not a generic error
error_choice_separation.CONFLICT: identity/precondition conflict; not a semantic choice result
error_choice_separation.BLOCKED: prerequisite not satisfied; not an external unknown outcome
error_choice_separation.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: authoritative readback is required; not verified success and not proof of no effect
error_choice_separation.FAILED_NO_EFFECT: failure with proven no requested effect; not unknown and not a choice

B014_F_RC2_1_safety.usable_success_rule: A result is usable as authoritative success only when mutation_effect is APPLIED_VERIFIED or REPLAYED_VERIFIED and authoritative_effect_confirmed=yes.
B014_F_RC2_1_safety.unknown_rule: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN must not expose verified success, worker/handoff/ack success, or an equivalent usable success projection.
B014_F_RC2_1_safety.failure_rule: If authoritative materialization fails or remains unknown, the canonical result must expose that state and cannot hide it behind local handler success.

EXAMPLE_D.name: same idempotency key / same intent replay

EXAMPLE_E.name: same idempotency key / different intent conflict
